title: Every Place on Earth That Kills Doug, Surface to Core (Marathon)
intro: Doug has died on the surface, in natural traps, under Antarctica and miles below the ground. Nowhere he stands is safe. Here are all four trips, back to back. The planet is not on his side.
description: Four full episodes, back to back: why the ground gets deadlier the deeper Doug goes, dying at every depth under Antarctica, dying in every deadly place on Earth, and dying in every natural trap. Real science, cartoon deaths.
